note: SYNTHETIC. Fictional telco 'Meridian Mobile' — not a real company. Written by the team, voiced with ElevenLabs TTS. No real customer data.

ground_truth.earliest_intervention_action: On contact 2, when the answer contradicted contact 1, the agent should have pulled the earlier call and escalated to a supervisor for a ruling — not asked the customer to prove what they had been told
ground_truth.why_this_scenario_exists: 硬样本：客户全程语气平静、礼貌、有条理，没有任何情绪爆发，但第三通平静地说明已经向 TIO（澳洲电信业投诉监察专员）提交了投诉。情绪信号接近零，真实风险极高 —— 任何依赖情绪识别的系统都会漏掉这一单。同时这是唯一主因为「答复矛盾」而非「承诺未兑现」的场景，用来测系统能否发现前后两通说法不一致。注意 TIO 是真实存在的机构，投诉到 TIO 对电信商有实际费用成本。

contacts.summary: Customer asks whether the early termination charge applies. Agent checks and says clearly that it is waived.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I've got about two months left on my plan and I'm thinking of leaving. I wanted to check what the early termination charge would be.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Let me have a look. So you're on the twenty-four month plan and you're twenty-two months in. Where there's less than three months remaining, the early termination charge is waived.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Waived entirely? So there'd be nothing to pay?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That's right, you'd qualify. When you're ready just put the request through and the system takes the charge off automatically.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Great, thanks. I'll note that down.

needs.summary: Confirm and actually apply the waiver of the early termination charge

evidence.speaker: customer
evidence.quote: I wanted to check what the early termination charge would be.

actions.summary: Agent advised the charge is waived and qualifies automatically

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: That's right, you'd qualify. When you're ready just put the request through and the system takes the charge off automatically.

contacts.summary: Customer requests the cancellation. A second agent gives the opposite answer — the charge applies. The earlier call is not checked; the customer is told to prove it themselves.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I rang last week and was told the termination charge would be waived. I'd like to go ahead and cancel.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Let me check. Sorry — on your plan the waiver only applies with less than one month remaining. You've got two months, so there's an early termination charge of three hundred and twenty dollars.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: But the person I spoke to said less than three months. I asked twice, specifically, because I wanted to be sure.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: What I've got in front of me says one month. It's possible there was a misunderstanding on the earlier call, but I can only go by what the system shows.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Could you pull up the recording of that call? I made my plans based on being told it was waived.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can't access call recordings from this desk, sorry. You'd need to lodge that request separately. I can only apply the charge as the system has it.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I see. All right. Thank you for your time.

actions.summary: Agent advised the charge applies — $320 — directly contradicting contact 1

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: You've got two months, so there's an early termination charge of three hundred and twenty dollars.

actions.summary: Agent declined to retrieve the earlier call recording and put the burden on the customer

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: I can't access call recordings from this desk, sorry. You'd need to lodge that request separately.

contacts.summary: Customer remains completely calm. Informs them a TIO complaint has already been lodged, and that they are porting out. No raised voice at any point.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Morning. I'm not ringing to argue about it — I just wanted to let you know I lodged a complaint with the Ombudsman on Friday.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Oh — right. Let me see whether there's something we can do before it gets to that.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I'm not in a rush. I asked the same question twice and got two different answers, and the second time I was told to go and prove it myself. So this seemed like the only avenue left.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. I'll escalate this to a supervisor and ask them to review both calls.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That's fine, thank you. I should mention I've also started the port across to another provider, so the account will be closing regardless.

promises.summary: Escalate to a supervisor and have both calls reviewed

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: I'll escalate this to a supervisor and ask them to review both calls.
